password_login_disabled: Password sign-in is turned off. Use another sign-in method.
invalid_credentials: The username or password is incorrect, or the account is disabled. Check them and try again.
registration_closed: New registrations are closed. Contact the administrator if you need an account.
password_registration_disabled: Signing up with a password is turned off. Sign up with an email code or a linked account.
email_verification_required: A verified email address is required. Enter your email and its verification code.
verification_code_invalid: The verification code is incorrect or has expired. Check it, or request a new one.
verification_code_attempts_exhausted: Too many incorrect attempts, so this code no longer works. Request a new code.
email_code_auth_disabled: Email code sign-in is turned off. Use another sign-in method.
email_transport_unavailable: Email codes cannot be sent right now. Use another sign-in method.
original_password_incorrect: The current password is incorrect. Check it and try again.
oauth_provider_not_configured: This sign-in method is not available. Use another one.
oauth_cancelled: Authorization was cancelled, so you were not signed in.
oauth_provider_error: The sign-in provider returned an error. Try again later.
oauth_state_invalid: This sign-in attempt has expired. Start signing in again.
oauth_exchange_failed: Sign-in could not be completed with the provider. Try again later.
oauth_identity_invalid: Your identity from the sign-in provider could not be verified. Try again later.
oauth_login_failed: Sign-in did not complete. Try again later.
oauth_email_unverified: That account has no verified email address. Verify one with the provider, then try again.
oauth_email_conflict: This email address matches more than one account. Contact the administrator.
oauth_identity_conflict: This provider account is already linked to another user. Sign in as that user instead.
user_not_found: The user was not found. It may have been deleted; refresh the list.
user_exists: This username or email is already registered, or belonged to a deleted account. Choose another.
user_manage_forbidden: You cannot manage an account whose role is equal to or higher than yours.
user_role_elevation_forbidden: You cannot give an account a role equal to or higher than your own.
root_user_protected: This admin can't be disabled, deleted or demoted: you can't demote yourself or remove the last admin.
user_role_unchanged: This account already has that role.
balance_adjustment_reason_required: Enter a reason for the balance adjustment.
balance_adjustment_amount_zero: The adjustment amount cannot be zero. Enter a positive or negative amount.
username_invalid: Usernames are 2–20 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
username_unavailable: This username is taken or reserved. Choose another.
username_change_cooldown: A username can be changed once every {{cooldown_days}} days. Try again after the waiting period.
identity_unlink_unavailable: Linked sign-in methods cannot be removed yet.
